newsitem.title: USA: REMEC Inc to offer 2.75 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: REMEC Inc to offer 2.75 mln shares.

text.p: REMEC Inc said Wednesday it was making a public offering of 2.75 million shares of common stock at a price of $23.00 each.
The company said it had increased the size of the offering by 500,000 shares from a proposed offering of 2.25 million.
It said it was selling 2.0 million of the total, while shareholders were selling the other 750,000.
The company said it had granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 412,500 shares to cover possible over-allotment.
It said it will use the estimated $43 million in net proceeds for "general corporate purposes", including working capital.
It added that it will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale of shares by the shareholders.
REMEC's stock closed at 23-1/2 on the Nasdaq National Market on Wednesday.
